title: pluchea suaveolens
intro: Pluchea suaveolens, commonly known as the sweet leaf or silver leaf, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Pluchea suaveolens include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of infections and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
